name: work
description: Runs a project's work items from first idea to done: nine skills and six agents for requirements, solution design, sub-items, building, checking, and shipping, with the owner approving each gate. Works with a local .work-items/ folder or Notion.

interface.shortDescription: Run work items from first idea to done, with the owner approving each gate.
interface.longDescription: Nine skills that take a work item through the fourteen stages: work-on starts or continues work, work-status says where things stand, work-decide walks the owner through decisions, work-requirements interviews him, solution-design writes design options, work-organize handles sub-items and moved folders, work-check tests the result against the requirements, work-finish ships and closes, and work-delegate hands a goal to a team of agents. Every tracker uses the same stages, WORK-ITEM.md body, and DESIGN.md. In Codex the agent role files are passed to a native worker.
defaultPrompt: What do you need from me?
